status: Completed author review of adult oral tramadol card and scored form.

sources.scope: Tramadol appears in the local regulatory list. Exact capsule, stock and regimen are not established by this list.
Moderate pain, oral formulations, adverse effects, caution and dose reduction in organ impairment. No MSF numeric schedule is imported.

Indication restricted to pain requiring an opioid when alternatives are inadequate, organ impairment, respiratory depression, seizures, serotonin toxicity, adverse effects and mechanism. This is a corroborating oral tablet label rather than confirmation of a ward capsule.
Warns about additive sedation and respiratory depression including with gabapentinoids.
Sedation and CNS-depressant interaction warnings support caution with opioid coadministration.
